disagreements.topic: volatility targeting on a convex strategy
disagreements.a: AQR / Man AHL systematic tradition: scale position size to a volatility target
disagreements.b: trend-following CTA tradition (Parker, Chesapeake): do not scale; vol suppression truncates the right tail that IS the expectancy
disagreements.why: AQR / Man AHL systematic tradition and trend-following CTA tradition (Parker, Chesapeake) both made money and disagree on volatility targeting on a convex strategy.
